build_ctc_criterion: build a CTC loss criterion for speech recognition models using fairseq with configurable blank and padding indices
create_ctc_config: create a CtcCriterionConfig dataclass to configure CTC loss parameters like zero infinity and post processing strategy
run_ctc_forward: run the CtcCriterion forward pass to compute CTC loss and log probabilities for a speech recognition sample
test_reduce_metrics: test the reduce_metrics static method to aggregate CTC loss and WER metrics across distributed training workers
review_wer_computation: review the CtcCriterion forward method word error rate computation using editdistance and optional KenLM decoder
